reviewContractFollowup.scope: Every tracked sites/ file for each tested source revision, including documentation and tests. No private fixtures, credentials or compiled output.
reviewContractFollowup.reconstruction: Check out the published base with core.autocrlf=false so tracked LF bytes are preserved. Write each patchUtf8 string verbatim to a UTF-8 file without a BOM. Apply the first patch with git -c core.autocrlf=false apply; apply the second only to the first result. Verify the complete inventories and sites Git tree after each step. Later documentation-only edits are not part of these tested source inventories.
